summary: There's a force to you people feel before you say a word. Who you are and raw power run together, so you don't do small. You transform, or you take over.
body: There's a force to you people feel before you say a word. Who you are and raw power run together, so you don't do small. You transform, or you take over. This can make control, visibility, and power feel tightly linked. You may carry an intensity that intimidates, or a need to run the room you don't fully clock. Used well, you're the one who rebuilds from ash and comes back stronger. Used badly, you grip and dominate to feel safe. The work is letting your power transform you instead of spending it on everyone else.
gift: At your best: magnetic, regenerative, unkillable in the ways that count.
shadow: The trap: control dressed as leadership, and intensity that runs people off.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Aim the power at your own transformation
Let people in without managing them
Notice when control is really fear
dont: Run the room to feel safe
Dominate what you could just trust
